fields.schemeName: AICTE-Technical Book Writing & Translation Scheme
fields.briefDescription: AICTE-Technical Book Writing & Translation scheme has been launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) to promote the use of 'Scheduled Regional Language' in Technical Education for creating knowledge base in local language.

fields.schemeName: Distribution of Free House Sites to Scheduled Caste/Other Economically Backward Classes
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the homeless poor Scheduled Caste people, and other Economically backward class people, who meet the eligibility criteria, are provided housing sites to enable them to construct their own houses. Approximately 11,000 persons so far have benefitted from this scheme.

fields.schemeName: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Lifetime Achievement in Promotion of Sports & Games
fields.briefDescription: The award is given to the sportspersons who have not only good performances at National and International levels but also have continued to contribute to the promotion of sports and games in his/her individual capacity even after retirement from an active sporting career.

fields.schemeName: Free Supply of Sarees and Dhothies to the Poor People
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was introduced to provide two sets of clothing items to poor people (other than SC/Fisherman) once in a year as a measure of Social Security. The beneficiaries are identified based on the data from the Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department in Puducherry.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Award for Clean Houses
fields.briefDescription: “Grant of Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Award for Clean Houses” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to motivate the Scheduled Caste people to keep their houses neat and tidy. Incentives are in the form of household articles worth ₹500/-.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage of Poor Scheduled Caste Brides
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Marriage of Poor Scheduled Caste Brides” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to poor parents from Scheduled Castes for performing the marriage of their daughters.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Physically/Mentally Disabled Children of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, registered construction workers whose child has a disability of 40% or more will receive financial assistance.

fields.schemeName: Marriage Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Marriage Assistance” was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B), Labour Welfare Department, Government of Assam for providing financial assistance to the registered construction workers for the marriage of their children.

fields.schemeName: General Pension (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a pension shall be given to a registered beneficiary working as a building worker for not less than one year after the commencement of the Rules on completion of sixty years of age.

fields.schemeName: Swami Vivekananda Nishakta Swavlamban Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: “Swami Vivekananda Nishakta Swavlamban Protsahan Yojana ” is a Social Security Scheme by the Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand. The aim of the scheme is to provide social security to differently abled people aged five(5) years and above.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Pensioners Suffering From HIV and AIDS
fields.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance to Pensioners Suffering From HIV/AIDS” is a Social Security Scheme by the Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand which aims to provide social security through financial assistance to those persons who are suffering from HIV/AIDS.

fields.schemeName: Kaushal Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Uttar Pradesh Kaushal Vikas Mission (UPSDM) is a scheme launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to equip young people in the state with the necessary skills for employment.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to General Farmers for Sinking Tubewell
fields.briefDescription: “Assistance to General Farmers for Sinking Tubewell" was launched by the Dept of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, UT of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the farmers from the General Category are provided with a grant of 65% subsidy towards the construction of tubewell/filter point per individual.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Sinking Tubewell
fields.briefDescription: “Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Sinking Tubewell" was launched by Dept of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, UT of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the farmers from the SC Category are provided with a grant of 90% subsidy towards the construction of tubewell/filter points per individual.

fields.schemeName: Development of Strawberry Cultivation
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide farmers with quality and improved varieties of strawberry planting materials so as to encourage area expansion under this crop such that commercialization horticulture under this crop is achieved.

fields.schemeName: Assistance for Installation of Sprinkler / Drip Micro Irrigation Systems
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the Marginal Farmers, Small farmers, Scheduled Caste/ Schedule Tribe Farmers, Women Farmers, Big Farmers and Institutions are provided with a subsidy on the total cost or ₹ 25,000/‐ per hectare whichever is less for the installation of Sprinkler / Drip Micro Irrigation Systems.

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement of College Fees for Scheduled Caste Students in Professional Colleges (Top 20)
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, reimbursement of tuition fees and examination fees is facilitated for students who have achieved marks above 75% in the Higher Secondary Course Examination and secured a place in the 'Top 20' Rank. The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojna” is an old-age pension scheme implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Bihar to provide financial assistance to elderly citizens. Under the scheme, a monthly pension is given to individuals who are aged 60 years or above.

fields.schemeName: Cash Award to the Meritorious Visually Impaired Students Obtaining First Three Ranks at the State Level in the SSLC and HSC Examination
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to award cash prizes to meritorious differently-abled persons (visually challenged students) who are studying in government and private schools of Puducherry and secure first, second and third rank concerning total marks in the SSLC and HSC exams.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Stipend to Differently Abled Trainees
fields.briefDescription: "Grant of Stipend to Differently Abled Trainees" by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry was introduced to provide financial assistance to differently abled individuals undergoing technical or professional training. The objective is to enable them to successfully complete their training.

fields.schemeName: Vegetable Development Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to promote vegetable production through HYV Seeds/ Hybrids/ Improved/ Open Pollinated seedlings, including assistance to farmers.

fields.schemeName: Plant Protection Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to control pests and diseases including weeds and rodents of horticultural crops by the distribution of bio-pesticides/Bio-agents and equipment at 50% subsidy.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Women and Child Development
fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
fields.briefDescription: The Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar (PMRBP) is organized to celebrate the energy, determination, ability, zeal, and enthusiasm of our children.

fields.schemeName: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Initiative of the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities under the Madhya Pradesh started the scheme "Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridhavastha Pension Yojana" for the older age people of the state.

fields.schemeName: Free Motorized Tricycle Scheme for Persons with Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Free Motorized Tricycle Scheme for Persons with Disabilities”, who are facing the mainstream of society due to their disabilities are provided motorized tricycles free of cost to those unable to connect.

fields.schemeName: Motivation of Unemployed Persons to Start Self-employed Enterprises
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Motivation of Unemployed Persons to Start Self-employed Enterprises” by the Dept of Industries and Commerce, UT of Puducherry was introduced to encourage self-employment among the youth in manufacturing and service activities, supporting the growing economy of Puducherry.

fields.schemeName: Visitor's Award
fields.briefDescription: The Awards are given to recognize excellence in research and innovation of faculty members/researchers of the Central Universities

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to recognize and promote quality education amongst Students belonging to OBC, EBC and DNT categories by providing full financial support. The Scheme will cover OBC/EBC/DNT students for pursuing studies beyond Class XII.

fields.schemeName: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridh Ashram Mai Nivaasarat Ant-vasi Pension Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the Madhya Pradesh government provides financial support to the citizens who live in old age homes recognized by the Department of Social Justice.

fields.schemeName: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Parityakta Pension Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under the Scheme, Madhya Pradesh government provides financial benefits to Be from a family living below the poverty line.

fields.schemeName: Horticulture Mission for North Eastern Hill Scheme- Meghalaya
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to improve productivity, quality planting material, canopy management of fruit trees, support marginal and small farmers, upscaling protected cultivation, and drip irrigation.

fields.schemeName: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture Sub Scheme Horticulture Mission for North East and Himalayan Region- Meghalaya
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya to promote holistic growth of Horticulture sector thorough promotion, extension, post-harvest management, processing and marketing.

fields.schemeName: Fruit Processing Centre
fields.briefDescription: The objective of scheme is to disseminate technical knowhow to youth entrepreneurs, farmers & housewives through practical demonstration on importance of fruit preservation & to manufacture quality processed fruit products such as Squashes, Jams, Jelly & Juices under trade name ‘Meg Fruits Product'.

fields.schemeName: Production Incentive / Back-Ended Subsidy for Cultivation of Horticulture Crops
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the farmers who possess farmer's identity cards / authenticated land records/documents are provided with One-Time Assistance/ Bi‐Annual Assistance/ Annual Assistance for the Cultivation of Horticulture Crops such as Mango, Guava, and Sapota.

fields.schemeName: State Agriculture Scholarship for B.Sc. & M.Sc. Agriculture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “State Agriculture Scholarship for B.Sc. & M.Sc. Agriculture” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Nagaland to provide educational assistance to students who are undergoing undergraduate (B.Sc. Agriculture) and post-graduate programme (M.Sc. Agriculture).

fields.schemeName: Regional Centre for Training and Production of Mushroom
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to train farmers in the method of mushroom cultivation and to supply quality spawn and pasteurized compost to farmers.

fields.schemeName: "Subsidy for Cultivation of Fodder Crops" Component of the "Crop Production Technology" Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Subsidy for Cultivation of Fodder Crops" scheme was introduced by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this scheme, cash incentives are distributed to Farmers and Self Help Groups for undertaking fodder cultivation in the Puducherry region.

fields.schemeName: Soil Resource Management and Inputs Quality Control
fields.briefDescription: Through the scheme “Soil Resource Management and Inputs Quality Control", the farmers can give their soil and water samples to the soil testing lab for analysis and recommendation at completely free of cost.

fields.schemeName: Incentive For Eye Donors
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Incentive For Eye Donors” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to create awareness among the public about the eye donation and to pay an amount of incentive to the donors of eye. In this scheme, an amount ₹ 10,000/- per beneficiary is provided.

fields.schemeName: Agriculture Engineering (Mechanical) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide agricultural machinery such as power tillers/ bulldozers/ tractors etc. on hiring at subsidised rate.

fields.schemeName: Basic Agriculture Training Centre Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide short-term vocational training for rural educated unemployed youths in agriculture and allied sectors to develop entrepreneurship skills and employment generation.

fields.schemeName: "Training in Handicrafts" Component of the "Development Of Handicrafts" Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Training in Handicrafts" Component of the "Development Of Handicrafts" Scheme by the Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Puducherry, aims to create better employment opportunities and enhance the livelihood of the rural poor. The training adopts a Gurukulam model.

fields.schemeName: “Exposure Tour for the Coir Artisans” Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Exposure Tour For The Coir Artisans” by the Dept of Industries and Commerce, Union Territory of Puducherry is introduced for acquiring the latest techniques and innovative ideas in various coir units located in other states, the exposure tour will be conducted for the coir artisans.

fields.schemeName: "Entrepreneurship Development Programme" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide Entrepreneurship training, to encourage prospective entrepreneurs to start the coir industry. Awareness programmes will also be arranged for the existing coir industries about the modern technology and scheme, and incentives available under the State Grant.

fields.schemeName: "Monthly Grant To Old Crafts Persons (Pension)" Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Monthly Grant To Old Crafts Persons (Pension)” by the Department of Industries and Commerce, Union Territory of Puducherry, aims to provide pensions to artisans in their old age, recognizing their contribution to traditional crafts. Eligible craftspersons receive a monthly grant of ₹2,000/-.

fields.schemeName: "Conducting of Exhibitions" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Conducting of Exhibitions" aims to enhance awareness of diverse coir products and promote their market presence. It extends financial support, including a daily allowance of ₹150 per participant and travel reimbursements, to both local and outstation participants.

fields.schemeName: Insurance Scheme For Artisans Component of the Development of Handicrafts Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme "Insurance Scheme For Artisans", artisans are covered under Jana Shree Bima Yojana LIC or any other suitable policy. The premium amount, as stipulated in the insurance policy, is shared, with 50% from the Social Security Fund and the remaining 50% from the Government.

fields.schemeName: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Old Age Assistance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The aim of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to destitute, senior citizens who are without any means of subsistence and having no one to give financial support to them for their livelihood.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Sammaan Pension Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Samman Pension Yojana" (MVSYS) stands as a testament to the commitment of the Government of Rajasthan towards the welfare of its citizens, particularly those with disabilities.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Vriddhjan Samman Pension Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Rajasthan government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department launched the "Mukhyamantri Vriddhjan Samman Pension Yojana" program, a social welfare initiative that aims to improve the lives of senior citizens residing in the state by providing them with monthly financial assistance.
